notes: `מוֹצָא` is read as rule 46's recast headless relative rather than as a bare noun with `added` English; the phrasal particle *out* stays with the verb (rule 44).
`כַּאֲשֶׁר` → *according as* heads on the governing first morpheme and on the English token realizing its lexeme; heading the target on *according* was the competing reading (rules 23, 24).
`נְדָבָה` → *a freewill offering* heads on *freewill*, *offering* being the supplied generic (rule 31).
